meta.title: A live RFQ with a vendor's bid: "Messages" opens the "Messages" window

plan.title: Messages drawer opens from RFQ Responses

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with a vendor bid on the buyer's Responses tab.
Open the Messages window from the Responses screen.
Assert that the Messages window is open.
Assert that the window exposes the Message button.
Assert that opening Messages leaves the event on the Responses screen until an action in the window is pressed.
